citations.title: Endurance Training Intensity Distribution: Systematic Review and Meta-analysis (2025)
citations.claim: The reported overall comparisons did not establish a polarized-versus-pyramidal advantage for main outcomes; training level may matter.
citations.limitations: Study three-zone definitions must not be equated with an athlete's five heart-rate zones. This does not establish a universal 80/20 prescription.

rationale: Comfortable effort matched to reviewed availability.

validationIssues.message: Dose is an individualized coaching estimate, not a guarantee of safety.
